name: Hull MA
description: This keyword returns the Hull Moving average of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Hull Moving average of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632226630.png)

You can plot Hull Moving average on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot EMA of RSI, OPEN etc
